test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements carefully and decide which conclusion from the given options logically follows from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All pilots are professionals.

2. No professionals are unemployed.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f87153c59d8a0f21ab26deca09e0e2a7734b7e511669211e46d7e375b843dcb0.png] 

Conclusions:

Option 1) All professionals are unemployed → Does not follow (As no professionals are unemployed. As direct relation is given between professionals and unemployed, therefore it is false.)

Option 2) Some professionals are unemployed → Does not follow (As all pilots are professionals and no professionals are unemployed. As direct relation is given between professionals and unemployed, therefore it is false.)

Option 3) No pilots are unemployed → **F**ollow (As all pilots are professionals and no professionals are unemployed. As whole pilot comes in professionals which cannot be unemployed, therefore it is true.)

Option 4) All pilots are unemployed → Does not follow (As all pilots are professionals and no professionals are unemployed. As whole pilot comes in professionals which cannot be unemployed, therefore it is false.)

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
